tadackosdrinks.guide.title: Tadacko's Drinks Guide
tadackosdrinks.guide.toc.title: Table Of Contents
tadackosdrinks.guide.p2.title: Introduction
tadackosdrinks.guide.p2.body: Welcome to Tadacko's Drinks. This mod is mainly focused on semi-realistic implementation of alcoholic beverage production processes and the effects of alcohol. The drinks in this mod also have beneficial secondary effects**. This book will serve as your guide. You can use the Table Of Contents to quickly navigate through the book by clicking on the titles. If you ever lose this book, you can craft it like this:
tadackosdrinks.guide.p3.title: Mechanics
tadackosdrinks.guide.p3.body: Many features in this mod (anything marked "**" in this book) can be customized in the config. If you don't want to deal with config files you can use a mod like Configured or Forge Config Screens to access the config from the GUI (Title Screen/Pause Menu -> Mods -> Tadacko's Drinks -> Config). Most interactions in this mod are done with right-click. You can place down and pick up drinks by crouch right-clicking. You can attach a Clock to a Fermenting Barrel, Pot Still or Column Still by right-clicking and remove it by crouch right-clicking.
tadackosdrinks.guide.p5.title: Crops-Barley
tadackosdrinks.guide.p5.body: Crop similar to Wheat. Seeds drop from Grass. Can be grown on normal Farmland. Can be used to craft Bread.
tadackosdrinks.guide.p6.title: Crops-Hops
tadackosdrinks.guide.p6.body: Seeds drop from Vines. Can only be planted on Farmland with Rope above it. Rope can only be placed underneath a Trellis and then extended down by placing more Rope. Right-click when fully grown to harvest 1-2 Hops.
tadackosdrinks.guide.p8.title: Crops-Grapes
tadackosdrinks.guide.p8.body: Seeds drop from Vines. Can only be planted on Farmland with a Trellis above it. Spreads upwards onto other Trellises and sideways onto Trellis Wires. Trellis Wires can only be placed between 2 Trellises. Right-click horizontal parts when fully grown to harvest 4 Grapes. Grapes are edible (2 nutrition, 0.8 saturation).
tadackosdrinks.guide.p10.title: Crops-Juniper
tadackosdrinks.guide.p10.body: Grows in cold and forested biomes. Right-click when fully grown to harvest 2-3 Juniper Berries. Juniper Berries are used for planting and are edible (1 nutrition, 0.2 saturation), but have a 5%% chance to cause Hunger I for 1 minute.
tadackosdrinks.guide.p11.title: Crops-Agave
tadackosdrinks.guide.p11.body: Grows in arid biomes. Harvesting when fully grown drops Agave Piña and 1-4 Agave Shoots. Agave Shoots are used for planting.
tadackosdrinks.guide.p12.title: Effects-Inebriation
tadackosdrinks.guide.p12.body:
Gained by drinking alcohol. Intensity and duration are based on blood alcohol content, calculated BAC%%=ABV⋅V⋅ρ/(m⋅r⋅10) where ABV is the alcohol by volume of a drink in decimal, V is the volume of a drink in l, ρ is the density of ethanol in g/l (789.5 g/l), m is body weight in kg (default 70 kg**) and r is the alcohol distribution ratio in decimal (default 0.7**). BAC decreases by 0.15%%/h (10x real life speed)**.

On all levels of Inebriation a Camaraderie effect is applied, which gives you the equivalent of ½ Strength and ½ Resistance** for every other player within 50 blocks** and stacks up to 4 (level V)**.
tadackosdrinks.guide.p12+.table.4.2:
Bad Luck I, Mild Nausea II,
Slowness I, Camaraderie,
Stumble
tadackosdrinks.guide.p12+.table.5.2:
Bad Luck II, Nausea,
Slowness II, Mining fatigue I,
Weakness I, Blindness,
Poison I, Camaraderie, Stumble
tadackosdrinks.guide.p13.title: Effects-Hangover
tadackosdrinks.guide.p13.body: Gained when Inebriation wears off and you reached Inebriation III-V (translating to Hangover I-III) during your drinking session. Being hungover makes you sensitive to bright light sources and loud sounds which will also damage you at level III. Other effects are also applied, refer to the table below.
tadackosdrinks.guide.p13.table.2.2: Weakness I, Vulnerability I*, Light/Sound Sensitivity
tadackosdrinks.guide.p13.table.3.2: Weakness II, Vulnerability II*, Light/Sound Sensitivity Damage
tadackosdrinks.guide.p13.footnote: *Vulnerability is the opposite of Resistance, meaning it increases damage taken by 20%% per level**.
tadackosdrinks.guide.p13+.body: A Hangover isn't curable using Milk. Instead, you will need the Hangover Cure. Use the crafting recipe below.
tadackosdrinks.guide.common.yeast_text: Refer to the {{Generic Processes-Yeast|16}} page for information on how to make it.

tadackosdrinks.guide.p28.title: Distillation
tadackosdrinks.guide.p28.body: There are 2 ways to distill liquids. Both require a heat source below and a Condenser next to any still block with a Cauldron below the Condenser. The Pot Still is a simple and compact solution - add your input liquid into the block, wait 2 minutes and the result is deposited into the Cauldron. However, it will require multiple distillation runs to create usable spirit and it is incapable of making Rectified Spirit. The Column Still always yields the same result for a given height, taking 1-2 minutes to finish, depending on height. It is made up of Column Still blocks stacked on top of each other, supported heights being 2, 4, 6 and 8 blocks tall.

tadackosdrinks.guide.p37.title: Vodka-Effects
tadackosdrinks.guide.p37.part1.table.1.1:
Grape, Apple, Honey,
Sugarcane, Potato, Agave
tadackosdrinks.guide.p37.part2.title: Charisma
tadackosdrinks.guide.p38.title: Gin-Production
tadackosdrinks.guide.p38.node1.title: Any Wash
tadackosdrinks.guide.p38.node1.text: Any fermented liquid will work. Refer to their respective pages for information on how to make them.
tadackosdrinks.guide.p38.node2.title: Distillation
tadackosdrinks.guide.p38.node2.text: Distill the Wash into Mid-Proof Spirit. Refer to the {{Distillation|30}} page for more information.
tadackosdrinks.guide.p38.node3.title: Spicing
tadackosdrinks.guide.p38.node3.text: Add 4 Juniper Berries into a Mid-Proof Spirit filled Cauldron to spice it.
tadackosdrinks.guide.p38.node4.title: Juniper Berries
tadackosdrinks.guide.p38.node4.text: Refer to the {{Crops-Juniper|10}} page for more information.
tadackosdrinks.guide.p38.node5.title: Distillation
tadackosdrinks.guide.p38.node5.text: Distill the Spiced Mid-Proof Spirit into High-Proof Spirit. Refer to the {{Distillation|30}} page for more information.
tadackosdrinks.guide.p38.node6.title: Dilution
tadackosdrinks.guide.p38.node6.text: Concentrated Gin must be diluted to drinking strength. Use the crafting recipe below.
tadackosdrinks.guide.p38.node8.title: Gin
tadackosdrinks.guide.p38.node8.text: Right-click with empty Shot Glasses to fill them. 1 Bucket of Gin = 20 Gin Glasses.
tadackosdrinks.guide.p39.title: Gin-Effects
tadackosdrinks.guide.p39.part1.table.1.1:
Grape, Apple, Honey,
Sugarcane, Potato, Agave
tadackosdrinks.guide.p39.part2.title: Savagery
tadackosdrinks.guide.p39.part2.body: Increases damage dealt by critical hits.
tadackosdrinks.guide.p40.title: Tequila-Production
tadackosdrinks.guide.p40.node1.title: Agave Wash
tadackosdrinks.guide.p40.node1.text: Refer to the {{Generic Washes-Agave|28}} page for information on how to make it.
tadackosdrinks.guide.p40.node2.title: Distillation
tadackosdrinks.guide.p40.node2.text: Distill the Agave Wash into Mid-Proof Spirit. Refer to the {{Distillation|30}} page for more information.
tadackosdrinks.guide.p40.node3.title: Aging
tadackosdrinks.guide.p40.node3.text: Optional: The spirit can be aged by leaving it in a Fermenting Barrel for 8h of real time.
tadackosdrinks.guide.p40.node4.title: Dilution
tadackosdrinks.guide.p40.node4.text: Concentrated Tequila must be diluted to drinking strength. Use the crafting recipe below.
tadackosdrinks.guide.p40.node6.title: Tequila
tadackosdrinks.guide.p40.node6.text: Right-click with empty Shot Glasses to fill them. 1 Bucket of Tequila = 20 Tequila Glasses.
tadackosdrinks.guide.p41.title: Tequila-Effects
tadackosdrinks.guide.p41.body: Distributes a multiple of its duration to all currently applied effects.
